uncited: **Top-Level Cells Array:** One entry per top-level cell.
**Leaf Array:** Stores start/end indices into the Reference Array for each leaf cell.
**Reference Array:** A single contiguous array storing pairs of `(leaf_cell_index, primitive_reference)`.
Each primitive is referenced once per overlapping leaf cell.
**Get Top-Level Pairs:** Extract sorted pairs of `(Cell Index, Primitive ID)` from the temporary grid into $Atl_p$.
**Compute Leaf Cell Locations:** Initialize accumulator array $Acc$ of size $r_x \cdot r_y \cdot r_z + 1$ with zeros.
Count leaf cells per top-level cell using bounds $b$, resolution $r$, and ranges $tlc$: $Acc \leftarrow \text{COUNT LEAF CELLS}(b, r, tlc)$.
Perform exclusive scan on $Acc$: $Acc \leftarrow \text{EXCLUSIVE SCAN}(Acc, r_x \cdot r_y \cdot r_z + 1)$.
**Compute Reference Array Size:** Initialize accumulator array $Arc$ of size $G+1$ (where $G=128$) with zeros.
Count leaf references per top-level cell using a fast conservative triangle-cell intersection test (bounding box only): $Arc \leftarrow \text{COUNT LEAF REFS}(t, b, r, n, Atl_p, tlc)$.
Perform exclusive scan on $Arc$: $Arc \leftarrow \text{EXCLUSIVE SCAN}(Arc, G+1)$.
**Fill Reference Array:** Write pairs `(Leaf Location, Primitive ID)` to $A_p$.
The leaf location is computed from the leaf index and the location of the first leaf for the corresponding top-level cell.
Use a more precise test (including plane intersection) when generating these pairs.
**Top-Level Step:** The ray steps through the top-level grid.
If a top-level cell is empty, the ray skips it.
**Leaf-Level Step:** Each top-level cell is treated as a uniform grid.
- **Memory Complexity:** Linear in the number of primitives and cells.
